about: BP Portfolio cover history: one entry per live cover, newest publishedAt first, so the first N entries are 'the last N covers' for the rotation rules in docs/CONTENT_IMAGERY.md section 9. A new article's cover is inserted in descending publishedAt order (at the top only when it is the newest post); a new cover on an existing post updates that post's entry in place and moves the old cover into a 'previous' list (section 13). Sources: the receipts posted on brandonperfetti/bp-portfolio#415, a read of the production posts API on 2026-11-22, and the prompt Midjourney embedded in each cover's original PNG on Cloudinary (finalPrompt).

verified.method: GET https://brandonperfetti.com/api/posts?limit=0&depth=1 (anonymous, published only): every heroImage and meta.image id equals mediaId, and every mediaFilename is the last two segments of cloudinaryPublicId joined by '-' plus '.jpg'. A HEAD of each cloudinaryPublicId at its version on res.cloudinary.com returned 200 (53/53); controls: an unused cover-mj-B and cover-gpt-B id returned 404. finalPrompt is the PNG Description text chunk of each original (GET at its version, 53/53), and each PNG's XMP DigImageGUID equals the receipt's job id (the upscale job for the first 9).
